fact: The party arrives at the entrance to the Lost Tomb of Khaem after several days of travel.
source_quote: After several days of travel, the party arrives at the entrance to the Lost Tomb of Khaem.
subject: Lost Tomb of Khaem

fact: Sarith announces "Aha, we have arrived."
source_quote: Sarith announces "Aha, we have arrived."
subject: Sarith

fact: Fuurm is pleased with full bellies.
source_quote: Fuurm and Baedora are pleased, with full bellies
subject: Fuurm

fact: Baedora is pleased with full bellies.
source_quote: Fuurm and Baedora are pleased, with full bellies
subject: Baedora

fact: Gyrgum wagers that the crystals will prove useful, and Jimjar accepts the bet.
source_quote: Gyrgum wagers that the crystals will prove useful, and Jimjar accepts.
subject: crystal wager

fact: Jimjar offers a bet that no one will agree whether the crystals were useful, which no one takes.
source_quote: Jimjar then wonders aloud "Who decides?" and offers a bet that no one will agree whether the crystals were useful. Nobody takes it
subject: crystal utility bet

fact: Jimjar is disappointed that no one took his bet but understands.
source_quote: he is "disappointed with all of you" but understands.
subject: Jimjar

fact: A faint, feminine voice speaks telepathically to the party, begging to be freed from the darkness.
source_quote: A faint, feminine voice speaks telepathically to the party, begging to be freed from the darkness.
subject: telepathic plea

fact: The voice gives the party a sense of the entrance's direction, matching their current path.
source_quote: The voice gives the party a sense of the entrance's direction, which is the way they were already going.
subject: direction sense

fact: The party proceeds cautiously toward a large set of double doors.
source_quote: They proceed "cautiously." The party approaches a large set of double doors leading into the tomb.
subject: approach doors

fact: Gyrgum attempts to throw a crystal to collect on his bet, but the GM rules it is not the time.
source_quote: He tries to throw a crystal and collect on his bet, but the GM rules it isn't the time.
subject: crystal throw attempt

fact: The double doors are the only way forward into the tomb.
source_quote: The double doors are the only way forward
subject: Tomb Entrance

fact: Inside the entrance, the party discovers a stone diorama of the sorcerer Brysis of Khaem.
source_quote: the party discovers a stone diorama of the sorcerer Brysis of Khaem
subject: Brysis Diorama

fact: The tomb entrance contains murals of floating Netherese cities.
source_quote: and murals of floating Netherese cities.
subject: Tomb Entrance

fact: A 24 on Arcana confirms the location is Brysis's tomb and contains powerful magic.
source_quote: A 24 on Arcana confirms this is Brysis's tomb and that powerful magic lies within.
subject: arcana check

fact: The Netherese had floating cities and access to magic no longer available.
source_quote: The Netherese had floating cities and access to magic no longer available.
subject: Netherese Empire

fact: The Netherese empire ended when a leader's ritual almost tore reality apart.
source_quote: Their empire ended when a leader's ritual almost tore reality apart.
subject: Netherese Empire

fact: Netherese items are in high demand and have been heavily plundered.
source_quote: Their items are in high demand and have been heavily plundered.
subject: Netherese Empire

fact: The Netherese definitions of good and evil may not map to the party's own.
source_quote: Their definitions of good and evil may not map to the party's.
subject: Netherese Empire

fact: Gyrgum remarks that the disclaimer about Netherese morality applies to pretty much anything.
source_quote: Gyrgum remarks that the last point is "a good disclaimer for pretty much anything."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party descends a dusty staircase extending over a hundred feet into the earth.
source_quote: The group descends a dusty staircase extending over a hundred feet into the earth
subject: Staircase

fact: A Netherese calendar stone is set into the wall along the staircase.
source_quote: passing a Netherese calendar stone set into the wall
subject: Netherese calendar stone

fact: Gyrgum goes first on the staircase to avoid triggering traps that might drop him into a pit.
source_quote: Gyrgum goes first, hoping to avoid "the stair that immediately crumbles and drops me to a pit."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz reports a passive Perception of 15 and an Investigation of 17.
source_quote: Daz reports passive Perception 15 and Investigation 17
subject: Daz

fact: The GM keeps Daz, described as a magic user who is "more fungible in a disaster," out of the front.
source_quote: the GM keeps the fragile magic user out of the front.
subject: Daz

fact: The GM describes the calendar stone as containing "just the calendar" with no notable dates.
source_quote: the GM says it's "just the calendar."
subject: Netherese calendar stone

fact: Gyrgum expresses hope that the calendar is a perpetual calendar.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "I do hope it's a perpetual calendar."
subject: Gyrgum

subject: Shrine

fact: The shrine contains a cracked marble altar.
source_quote: discovering a cracked marble altar.
subject: Marble Altar

fact: The party observes that nothing in the shrine has turned to dust after several thousand years.
source_quote: The party observes that after several thousand years, nothing has turned to dust.

source_quote: that leave no tracks in the thick layer of dust on the floor

source_quote: Zalthir rolls a natural 1 on Investigation
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir becomes convinced there is "proof here of a lower power."

subject: Zalthir

source_quote: Gyrgum rolls a 17 on Arcana
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum recalls from his days with Bahamut that such undead don't rest but are driven to keep searching.
source_quote: recalls from his days with Bahamut that such undead don't rest but are driven to keep searching.

fact: Gyrgum suggests the undead hate things they were associated with in life.
source_quote: Gyrgum suggests the undead simply hate things they were associated with in life.

source_quote: There are doors to the east and south
subject: Shrine

fact: There is no sign indicating which way the undead went from the shrine.

source_quote: Daz examines the altar but finds no arcane significance (Arcana 16).
subject: Daz

fact: Fargas Rumblefoot tipped the party that the tomb held a secret, false tomb.
source_quote: The party also recalled Fargas Rumblefoot's tip that the tomb held a secret, false tomb.

fact: Fargas did not know the location of the secret room, only that other visitors were unaware of it.
source_quote: Fargas didn't know where the secret room was, only that other visitors hadn't known about it.
subject: Fargas Rumblefoot

fact: Fargas was the last member of his adventuring group, suggesting his companions died along the way.
source_quote: Fargas was the last of his own adventuring group, so his companions may simply have died along the way.
